title: Limatus evaluations harness
description:
# Limatus evaluations harness

## Intent

Regression evaluations so Limatus diagnose findings and rewrite-option quality can improve safely.

## Done when

- Fixture corpus of drafts + expected finding classes / acceptable option properties.
- Offline-friendly eval runner (deterministic where possible; LLM judges gated and versioned).
- Metrics: precision/recall on finding types, unsupported-claim rate in options, human-accept proxies.
- CI smoke subset without Papyrus.
- Documented how Ryan rejects become new fixtures.
